description: Java class defining the ConceptDescription entity within the OpenMRS project, modeling localized descriptions for medical concepts with auditing and metadata.

classes.name: ConceptDescription
classes.description: Represents a localized description of a medical concept, including metadata such as creation and modification info, using Hibernate Envers auditing.

methods.name: getConceptDescriptionId
methods.description: Gets the primary key ID of this ConceptDescription record.

methods.name: setConceptDescriptionId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID for this ConceptDescription.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Associates a Concept object with this description.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the Locale indicating the language/region of this description.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the Locale for this description.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Retrieves the User who created this record.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when this record was created.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the User who last modified the record.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who last modified the record.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last change.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the description string for display.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements the OpenmrsObject getId method, returning the concept description ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements the OpenmrsObject setId method, setting the concept description ID.
